citations.quote: Seitdem will meine Tochter (5) nicht mehr in die Küche, sie wacht nachts auf, weil sie Angst hat, "dass es wieder brennt", und klagt morgens über Kopfweh.
Ob die Heizung tatsächlich nicht richtig läuft oder ob es einfach am Wetter liegt, kann ich nicht beurteilen.
Ich werde den Mietzins ab dem nächsten Monat bei der Schlichtungsbehörde hinterlegen, wenn die Küche bis dahin nicht repariert ist.
Vermieterin: Domicil Plus Immobilien AG, Solothurnstrasse 17, 2540 Grenchen

plan.because: The supplied contract identifies the parties, property and tenancy terms.
Obtain both reports to establish their contents and dates.
Establish whether and when the landlord received the reports.
Obtain dated evidence of the affected kitchen and any visible defect.
Document the reported lack of response and any proposed work or access arrangements.
Mould is unmentioned and presumed absent for planning.
A heating fault is raised but remains uncertain.
Health effects are reported; obtain any medical findings without assuming their cause.
A specialist inspection is not mentioned and is presumed absent for this evidence plan. Immediate electrical safety nevertheless needs urgent attention.
Rent deposit is contemplated; establish any communicated deadline, recipient and notice contents.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: Is there an immediate electrical or fire danger? Avoid using the affected sockets and arrange urgent safety assistance; contact emergency services if there is an immediate threat.
Has the child received medical attention for the headaches or sleep disturbance, and is a confirmation available?
Is the heating faulty, or has it been checked or measured?
When and how were the two defect reports sent, and is there proof of delivery?
Has a written repair deadline been communicated to the landlord? If so, please provide it before taking deposit steps.
